**Access boundary:** Restricted operator authority required.

Subsequent 7 November prevention engine, additive migration 0074, private report and operational-notification outbox are implemented locally, not deployed or activated. The notification gate defaults off; production migration/runtime release, exact operator-envelope/cap activation, scheduled claim, provider acknowledgement and actual receipt need separate authorization and proof. The already applied native separation below is a fallback/noise mitigation, not prevention of authority expiry. On 7 November 2026, production 1.1.31 source 4e238991 serves the existing marker runtime. Read-only D1 and scheduled-runtime evidence confirm exactly one expired operator fax authority, zero current freshness-check failures, healthy France/Germany and Resend source maintenance, and no production dispatches/attempts since 2 November or older in-flight/unknown commitments. Native Safari reread the two-monitor inventory and existing combined five-minute/hourly configuration after the documented policy API returned 403. The local separation planner passes 26 focused regressions. Around 23:51 UTC on 6 November (7 November in Paris), the separated technical and freshness queries were saved and reread with five-minute execution, hourly technical reminders and 168-hour freshness reminders. All three native monitors remain enabled, with the existing single destination and heartbeat unchanged. The independent freshness monitor was saved more than five minutes before changing the original query. Both SQL previews validated; actual scheduled native results and new notification/resolution email receipts remain unobserved. The independent Luxembourg extension PR #142 remains draft/open and unactivated; its genuine expired deadline is unchanged. Historical 31 October/1 November runtime and receipt observations remain dated; no application deployment, merge, provider authority change or customer communication is part of this change.

**Surfaces:** Existing private scheduled maintenance, same-account ProviderInspection service-binding RPC and read-only operator CLI, GitHub scanner watchdog and separately authorized native monitors; no public browser, REST, MCP or native maintenance/activation surface. Operational email requires a separately authorized production gate/envelope and provider configuration.
